releaseNotes.zh-CN: 修复重启后的首次加载：模块加载时后台预读缓存；未变化图标可跨重启保留30天，并按源文件大小、修改时间和提取版本失效。首次界面先使用持久化快照，后台刷新桌面；避免初始化时逐个解析断开磁盘上的保存路径。Everything在启用后后台初始化，图标提取、桌面扫描、索引及搜索相互隔离，慢任务通过短请求异步轮询，避免占用宿主串行IPC。搜索结果仍保持1分钟有效期，索引状态仍实时验证。新增启动计时日志和跨进程缓存回归测试。
releaseNotes.en-US: Warm disk caches when loading; retain unchanged, source-versioned icons for 30 days across reboots. Render persisted state immediately, refresh Desktop off-thread, and avoid canonicalizing saved paths during hello. Initialize Everything after activation in a separate worker; isolate Shell icon and Desktop work with bounded asynchronous task receipts so slow startup cannot monopolize host IPC. Query pages retain their 60-second freshness window and readiness remains live. Adds startup timing diagnostics and restart/latency regression coverage.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 缩小、调淡启动台主面板阴影，使其自然跟随面板圆角，不再超出透明窗口留白后被截成方形。阴影范围随窗口宽度调整，同时收敛各皮肤的过大外发光和投影；保持面板尺寸和图标入场动画不变。
releaseNotes.en-US: Reduce the panel shadow and keep its rounded falloff inside the transparent window gutter, avoiding rectangular clipping. Scale shadow bounds with the responsive gutter and constrain appearance-specific glows. Preserve panel geometry and icon entrance motion.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 修复快捷键唤醒时白色面板抖动：移除面板位移缩放，仅保留可见图标的入场动画；取消 900ms 时间门限，快速再次唤醒也可播放图标动画。修复部分图标主体过小：优先比较真实原生图标细节，裁除过大留白和浅色外框，并使旧图标缓存自动失效。
releaseNotes.en-US: Keep the Launcher shell stationary on wake and animate only visible icon glyphs. Remove the 900ms gate so rapid reopen reliably replays the icon wave. Normalize oversized Shell icon canvases, prefer native detail, remove excessive padding/faint framing and invalidate old icon-cache entries.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 新增默认开启的 Everything 搜索结果与高清图标缓存，可在启动台设置中关闭或清理；缓存有容量上限并自动过期，保留应用和文件夹配置。缩小设置弹窗阴影并将遮罩限制在启动台内部；合并重复唤醒动画，避免快捷键打开时闪烁。
releaseNotes.en-US: Add default-on bounded disk caches for Everything result pages and high-resolution icons, with settings to disable or clear them. Preserve apps and folders. Reduce the settings shadow and contain the backdrop within Launcher. Coalesce duplicate reveal animations without blanking an already visible panel.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 启动台设置加入 Everything 结果数量（默认 200）和可选分批加载（默认关闭）；输入 / 可补全搜索指令并自动加空格，支持鼠标与键盘操作。
releaseNotes.en-US: Add a configurable Everything result limit (default 200), opt-in batch loading and slash-command completion with a trailing space. Preserve existing Launcher UI and interactions.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 修复桌面迁移到 D 盘等位置后无法识别的问题：跟随 Windows 实际桌面及 OneDrive 重定向位置，合并公共桌面，去重重复路径并记录读取失败原因；保持现有布局、拖拽、文件夹和搜索行为。
releaseNotes.en-US: Follow the current Windows desktop and OneDrive redirection instead of guessed paths, include public desktop shortcuts, deduplicate paths and log resolution/read failures. Preserve layout, drag sorting, folders and search behavior.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 重做启动台界面与皮肤适配，加入图标入场、悬停和点击动画、栏目滑块、拖拽落位提示及 Everything 关键词高亮。安装包改由 modules 分支固定提交交付。
releaseNotes.en-US: Refresh Launcher layout and skins with icon entry, hover and launch animations, sliding mode tabs, drag drop-slot feedback and Everything match highlighting. Deliver the package from a pinned modules commit.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 已发布的 Rust/Tauri 独立模块版本。本地后续改动尚未发布。
releaseNotes.en-US: Published Rust/Tauri module generation. Subsequent local changes are not published yet.
